note: Rio Grande NF (Saguache RD) campground at ~10,000 ft near Cochetopa Pass, 1 mile east of the Continental Divide Trail, on Otto Mears' 1876 Saguache toll road; reached via CO-114 then ~11 mi of gravel FR 750/CR NN14. Has 3 horse corrals but is a general drive-in campground. --Claude
summary: FS page: confirmed 5 sites (3 pull-through), max trailer 25 ft, vault toilet, no water, FCFS, $10 (2026), phone 719-655-2547 (Saguache RD); added season 05-19 to 11-19 (2026) and senior-pass discount. Hookups left alone (page silent). Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Phone 719-655-2547 confirmed: Saguache Ranger District (FS page office block).

Max length quote: 'Parking is tight within the campground. The maximum trailer length is 25 feet.' (also 'Maximum trailer length is 25 feet. Narrow parking does not allow for large horse trailers.') 25 ft is over 23 ft, so a 23-ft rig fits, but with little margin.

Road: FS gives no route; 'Snow and muddy conditions may limit access to the campground during certain times of the year.' The Saguache district road table (last updated 5/11/2026) lists FR 750 Cochetopa Hills 'Open' and the Luders Creek Cg spur 'Open'. The Rio Grande NF's October 22-23, 2026 flood-damage list names no Saguache district roads. CO-114 over Cochetopa Pass is a paved state highway (state closures: cotrip.org). No 4WD or RV advice for the access road.
Status: FS banner 'Site Open'; season runs to Nov 18/19, 2026.

Waterfront: stored not waterfront. On imagery the sites sit at the west edge of an open meadow by the corrals; a willow-lined drainage (likely Luders Creek) runs ~60-80 m east across the open meadow. No water visible at that scale; not changed, a weak creekview lead at most.
Pin 38.17962,-106.58353 matches the FS page coordinate (38.17961508,-106.5835269). No catalog. OK.
